text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: PD - Ops (P0) -> inference-gateway-usw2 error-rate spike (5xx > 12% for 3m). Service: inference-gateway, route: /v1/generate, env: prod-usw2, alert-id: alert-1719998001

pagerduty: Autopage: Incident created -> Incident #INC-2026-1719998001. Escalation -> primary on-call.

Alice Nguyen: acked on PD, joining here. seeing 5xx spike in graphs.

Carla (on-call): I'm on it. Quick check: are errors concentrated on a single AZ or across all us-west2?

Ben Foster: looks cross-AZ. K8s pod restarts low. Error logs show upstream 502 from kvcache proxy occasionally and 504 on long requests. snippet from prod logs: 
```
2026-03-17T18:26:41Z ERROR http_handler.go:212 resp_status=502 path=/v1/generate latency_ms=1503 model=redwood-large
2026-03-17T18:26:42Z WARN  kvproxy.go:88  ttl=0 cache-miss downstream=503
```

Carla (on-call): thanks. initial mitigation plan: 1) route 30% traffic to fallback eu region, 2) reduce max_concurrency on inference-gateway to cut head-of-line, 3) scale dedicated pool for USW2 by +2 nodes. Executing now.

Dave (support): customer-facing ops: three B2B customers reported "503" in last 5m. I'm posting a short status to status.redwood.com.

Alice Nguyen: running command to adjust route weights: 
```
redwoodctl traffic-route set --service=inference-gateway --from=usw2 --to=euw1 --pct=30
```

Carla (on-call): scaled pool: 
```
redwoodctl pool scale --name=dedicated-usw2 --delta=2
```

Carla (on-call): reducing gateway concurrency: 
```
kubectl -n prod patch deployment inference-gateway --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"gateway","env":[{"name":"MAX_CONCURRENCY","value":"64"}]}]}}}}'
```

Ben Foster: routing change applied, pool scale started, concurrency reduced. Graphs latency dropping a bit but still ~6-8% 5xx.

pagerbot: PD update: INC-2026-1719998001 -> acknowledged by Alice Nguyen. Escalation paused.

Carla (on-call): digging into kvcache evictions - eviction rate spiked around 18:24 UTC. Might be mem pressure after recent quantization rollout. Marking rollout pinned. Rolling back model variant for canary traffic.

Alice Nguyen: rolling back canary on host group canary-quant: `deployctl rollback canary-quant --to=rev-20260310`

Ben Foster: after rollback, 5xx down to ~1.5% in last 2m, customers report fewer errors. Nice.

Dave (support): updated status page: "Mitigated: partial rollback + traffic redistribution. We'll post a follow-up."

Carla (on-call): handing off monitoring to night-shift oncall @Ben. Please keep an eye for flare-ups and PD re-alert if >5% for 5m. We'll open a postmortem to investigate kv cache tuning + rollout gating.

Ben Foster: taking handoff, watching dashboards. tagging follow-up owners: @Alice for rollout gating, @infra for kvcache mem tuning. :white_check_mark:

Alice Nguyen: noted. I'll start an eval run on canary quant profiles tomorrow and draft rollback criteria.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1719998001 -> status: Mitigated. Timeline logged. Postmortem requested.

Carla (on-call): thanks all. Good coordination — closing channel for active triage. Postmortem to be scheduled. :eyes:
